LanguageData.JSM_ModeSplitDesc: The other map takes half the screen. Click or scroll on it and it becomes the main map, the halves stay where they are.
LanguageData.JSM_ModeWindowDesc: The second map in a window you can move and resize. Click it to switch.
LanguageData.JSM_NoRenderer: This version of the game can't draw a map into a window.
LanguageData.JSM_LockDesc:
Off, when you go to someone from the colonist bar it shows on the half you clicked last.
On, it shows on the half that already has their map, and someone on a map that isn't on either half changes the half you clicked last.
LanguageData.JSM_Unlocked: Maps not locked to their half
LanguageData.JSM_SquareTip: Click to show it on this half, right click for the other half.
LanguageData.JSM_PickSquares: Squares at the edges of the screen
LanguageData.JSM_PickSquaresDesc: The split button splits the screen with the map you're on on both halves. Each half gets a column of squares at its edge, one for each map with colonists, click one to show it on that half. The small one under them is the lock.
LanguageData.JSM_PickPanel: A panel from the split button
LanguageData.JSM_PickPanelDesc: The split button opens a panel with a column for each half and every map in it.
LanguageData.JSM_SwitchTip: Make this the main map. Clicking the view does the same, at the spot you click.
LanguageData.JSM_UpdatesPerSecondDesc: Lower is lighter on the GPU. Moving or zooming the window always updates it right away.
